mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_cert (user_id, real_name, id_card, phone, emergency_contact, service_area, skill_tags, status, apply_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{realName}, #{idCard}, #{phone}, #{emergencyContact}, #{serviceArea}, #{skillTags}, 1, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer_cert SET real_name = #{realName}, id_card = #{idCard}, phone = #{phone}, emergency_contact = #{emergencyContact}, service_area = #{serviceArea}, skill_tags = #{skillTags}, status = 1, apply_time = NOW(), audit_admin = NULL, audit_opinion = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_cert WHERE status = 1
